title: Suggestions to improve the site and decision-making — reviewed BEFORE any implementation
policy: Nothing here is implemented. Each suggestion names the problem, proposes options with trade-offs, states what implementing it would DISCOVER, and waits for a reviewer to choose. Status is 'proposed' until a decision lands in data/decisions.json.

rows.problem: A reader cannot tell, from the landing page alone, which of the 22+ workspaces is authoritative for any question.
rows.suggestion: Add a one-screen 'workspace registry' table to the root dashboard: namespace, owner session, status (active/archived/read-only), what it is canonical for.

options.A: Static table maintained by the integration session
options.C: Do nothing; rely on nav groups

rows.discovers: the true overlap graph between namespaces (required before any deprecation)

rows.problem: Six price-snapshot stores will drift apart silently.
rows.suggestion: Freeze all but one store read-only at a cut date and have the site verifier cross-check the surviving store's counts weekly.

options.C: Keep all six, cross-check row counts

rows.discovers: which store's provenance survives a line-by-line re-read best

rows.problem: REQ-20 (price policy) blocks four downstream requirements.
rows.suggestion: Decide policy from three options: (1) third-party archive labelled THIRD-PARTY (works today, flagged); (2) licensed commercial feed (deferred until funded); (3) model-only lines, market columns permanently blank (pure origination research).
rows.discovers: whether residual/CLV views (REQ-18/58/59) can exist at all

rows.problem: The leaderboard's luck story is buried in analysis pages.
rows.suggestion: Build the REQ-16 'removal of luck' panel: for each ranked strategy show bootstrap CI, permutation p, record-baseline delta, and seeded-random delta in one row — numbers only from pre-registered, walk-forward data.

options.A: Panel on the canonical workspace only

rows.discovers: how much of any current edge survives luck removal (expected: none at current n)

rows.problem: Snapshot ledger exists but nobody sees designation evolution.
rows.suggestion: Render a 'Questionable -> Out' change log per week from the ledger deltas (two same-week captures minimum), linking both official captures.
rows.discovers: how often designations move after Wednesday — the raw material for REQ-12 surprise signals and REQ-43 calibration

rows.problem: REQ-38 wants durable storage outside the repo.
rows.suggestion: Options: (1) second private repo as snapshot mirror; (2) object storage (S3/R2) with hourly workflow push; (3) accept repo-only storage with documented risk.
rows.discovers: the repo-only failure mode (repo deletion/tampering removes the tamper-evident chain)

rows.problem: REQ-39 'private data layer' is approximated by not rendering raw rows.
rows.suggestion: Move row-level raw captures to a private repo and keep only derived counts public; or record an accepted exception.
rows.discovers: whether public raw captures create any terms/licensing exposure (needs the terms read, not guessed)

rows.problem: Venue data (REQ-23) is transcribed nowhere at scale.
rows.suggestion: Add venue to the fixture-context table by reading each game-centre page weekly in the scheduled workflow (14 reads/week) — store venue string + URL per game.

options.B: One-off season transcription from the schedule archive

rows.discovers: the first complete official venue dataset for 2026 (international + outdoor exposure for REQ-57)

rows.problem: The brief's REQ-66 asks for 2026 kickoff/onside-kick priors but no rule summary exists in-repo.
rows.suggestion: Extract the 2026 special-teams rule deltas from the official rulebook into a one-table summary with rule citations, before any model uses them.

options.B: Blocked behind a verified 2026 rulebook fetch

rows.discovers: whether 2026 actually changed kickoff/onside mechanics vs 2025 (the premise of REQ-66 is itself unverified)

rows.problem: Site navigation carries 22+ NFL workspaces; new readers cannot find the decision queue.
rows.suggestion: Pin three links at the top of the root dashboard: Decision-readiness table (this workspace), Flagged for Review, Suggestions — so review happens in one place before implementation anywhere.

options.B: Also mirror on each workspace landing page

rows.discovers: whether consolidation reduces duplicated suggestion queues across workspaces
